title: Annual economic schedule handoff fails existing Monte Carlo fixture
evidence: Full baseline fails expected complete→actual partial; synthetic reproduction identifies commercial year schedule mismatch, missing revenue bases and pending finance
engineering_impact: Assessment cannot produce complete metrics although equipment pricing succeeds
likelihood: Reproduced once in baseline and once synthetic diagnostic; wider prevalence unknown
proposed_resolution: Align annual schedules through authoritative adapter; preserve approval and existing evidence, then rerun exact fixture without weakening assertions

title: Source and configuration-level numerical sign-off incomplete
evidence: Stored citations, graph points and tests exist; original pages not rechecked in this audit
engineering_impact: Plausible deterministic numbers may still have wrong coefficients, units, basis or scope
likelihood: Extent unquantified; no industrial sign-off located
proposed_resolution: Version exact source excerpts privately, independently transcribe and hand-calculate representative/boundary cases per method

title: Current-year display can be consumer inflation proxy
evidence: Default policy permits general inflation proxy; target is 2026-09, FX snapshot is 2026-11-02; no live source revalidation
engineering_impact: Investor could confuse proxy with verified current equipment escalation; FX date differs from price period
likelihood: Code policy confirmed; exact source observations not checked
proposed_resolution: Require visible price basis/proxy label and independent source observation verification; do not silently relabel monthly/full-year or mix FX with inflation

title: Requested 13-field commercial contract not identified
evidence: Actual CommercialLine has 15 fields and other draft/schedule models exist
engineering_impact: Future schema edits could lose terms, approval or backward compatibility
likelihood: Contract ambiguity confirmed; data loss not demonstrated
proposed_resolution: Agree versioned field mapping and migration/backward compatibility tests; preserve six categories

title: Input metadata and conversion paths differ across adapters
evidence: vaporizer_area lists latent/fraction parameters while direct callable consumes duty,U,LMTD,F; Nottingham requires native coordinate rather than shared resolver conversions
engineering_impact: Caller can misunderstand whether phase duty is already calculated; equivalent inputs may be blocked by adapter
likelihood: Static mismatch; dimensional corruption not reproduced
proposed_resolution: Document actual parameter contracts and add cross-library dimensional/adapter parity cases before changing calculations

title: Parser layout and formula-cache limits
evidence: Bounded safe Excel reader uses stored values and 30-second worker; no formula recalculation; some real-file tests skipped
engineering_impact: Missing or stale workbook evidence can propagate into estimates if interpreted as current facts
likelihood: General risk; no new real-workbook acceptance run
proposed_resolution: Create permission-cleared workbook corpus and independent cell-level extraction/balance comparison; explicitly disclose stale/missing caches

title: AI conceptual suitability not independently established
evidence: Baseline provider tests are mocked; numerical arithmetic separate but model/context selection remains proposed
engineering_impact: Wrong family/configuration or assumption can dominate otherwise correct costing
likelihood: Not measured by this audit; no paid/live campaign
proposed_resolution: Use reviewed truth sets and suitability/rejection cases; persist rationale and separate source facts from assumptions

title: Installation/package and alias scope require reconciliation
evidence: Guarded purchased/installed/unit capital scopes exist; graph configuration installation factors can be missing; semantic aliases not proved by IDs
engineering_impact: Omitted auxiliaries, double installation or duplicate physical equipment can materially change CAPEX
likelihood: Safeguards tested synthetically; plant completeness not independently checked
proposed_resolution: Benchmark scoped packages, AB quantity and alias cases; independently reconcile purchase/installation/plant totals

title: Multiple orchestration and freshness contracts need parity
evidence: Independent block runners and connected pipeline call shared engines with different builders/dependencies
engineering_impact: Edits can expose stale or partial downstream values if optional bases are not invalidated consistently
likelihood: Potential; not all UI/API edit routes reconciled
proposed_resolution: Add contract tests for every edit→affected consumer, including reverse OPEX/WC/revenue dependencies; no second numerical engine

title: Financial conventions and report parity need signed verification
evidence: Discrete/continuous/uniform timing, annual ramp and unlevered planning policies explicit; complete browser/export reconciliation absent
engineering_impact: Wrong timing/base interpretation changes NPV/IRR even if arithmetic is consistent
proposed_resolution: Approve financial convention/reference schedules; compare UI/API/export hashes and ledger totals for one saved version

title: Live tenant security/version recovery not independently audited
evidence: Auth/tenant modes and optimistic writes exist; only local synthetic version tests executed; no production access inspection
engineering_impact: Potential sensitive assessment exposure or baseline loss; no exploit demonstrated
proposed_resolution: Engineer2 nonproduction tenant isolation, authorization, backup/restore and approved-revision tests; retain minimal permissions

title: Simulation uncertainty is not model completeness
evidence: Gaussian copula and bounded distributions; 18 disabled OpenPyTEA rows, missing bounds on 55 catalogue rows
engineering_impact: Percentiles could be misread as complete plant accuracy; unsupported scope cannot be sampled away
proposed_resolution: Validate dependence assumptions, failure-rate reporting, unsupported scope and representative-run reconciliation

title: Planned scenario UI and roadmap references diverge from code
evidence: Scenario scaffold; old parser/manifests absent; A–I roadmap differs from requested P0–P9
engineering_impact: Engineers can mistake planned/stale documentation for delivered acceptance evidence
proposed_resolution: Agree official P0–P9/G0, maintain actual-vs-planned and correct path/method inventory in future docs

title: Development discovery and reproducibility are incomplete
evidence: 127 untracked duplicates; original collection 2877 vs clean baseline 1720; no fresh offline dependency install available
engineering_impact: Different checkouts can run different suites; green unittest alone misses pytest functions
likelihood: Confirmed counts; fresh install blocked by missing local wheels
proposed_resolution: Owner review duplicates, install pinned clean environment in CI; never delete user files implicitly; run all test formats

title: Extrapolation and missing validity envelopes
evidence: Garrett allows flagged fitted extrapolation when unverified use accepted; OpenPyTEA rejects beyond published bounds and has provisional missing-bound mode
engineering_impact: Different libraries can produce/refuse a size for sound but non-equivalent reasons; large extrapolation is not verified design
likelihood: Confirmed policy differences; industrial validity unmeasured
proposed_resolution: Review exponent/applicability at boundaries and specify acceptance limits; no universal exponent invented

title: Dependency notices and CI are not full security assurance
evidence: Narrow secret patterns pass; notices reference absent manifests; no complete resolved SBOM/license/vulnerability audit; action tags are mutable
engineering_impact: Redistribution/credential/supply-chain risks may remain outside narrow checks
likelihood: No credential exposure confirmed by narrow scan
proposed_resolution: Engineer2 verify installed/transitive license/SBOM/security and pin CI actions where agreed; do not change original proprietary licence
